decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system. You will see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. Card payments work offline up to $250 each (we raised the limit from $100). It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app every few hours. If you need to move money, do it before Friday night. We added 150 support staff for these weeks.
decisions.why:
Tell customers early and exactly what will and will not work, before rivals and rumors do.
Early pay moves the Dec 11 paycheck before the freeze; the $250 limit covers holiday purchases.
Extra staff keeps the support wait short when questions peak (queue model).

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience during our system upgrade. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. No sign-up needed.
decisions.why:
Win back deposits after the migration week, when rivals advertise hardest.
New money only halves the cost versus a full boost.
The 4 weeks end on Jan 10, when deposits are measured.
